issues.claim: Spa Lady, 55 Lafayette Rd, Fords — listed as an active fitness center (source: us-business.info)
issues.problem: A different business, Mauka Fitness, publishes that exact address (55 Lafayette Rd, Fords, NJ 08863) on its own site. 'Spa Lady' is also a multi-location NJ women's fitness brand, i.e. a chain, which is an excluded type. Inference (not stated by any source): the Fords club has closed or been rebranded. Either way the entry is not a live, independent local business.
issues.fix: Remove the Spa Lady entry; if the location still trades, list Mauka Fitness after verifying ownership.

issues.claim: Home Well Senior Care, 386 New Brunswick Ave, Fords, (732) 738-0333 — home care agency
issues.problem: 'HomeWell Care Services' is a franchise system (HomeWell Franchising LLC files a public FDD) and its own locations pages do not show a Fords/Woodbridge office; NJ operations are listed out of Hackensack/Brick. The Fords address appears only in legacy aggregator data. Inference: stale listing of a franchise that is no longer at that address. Franchises are an excluded type.
issues.fix: Drop, or verify directly that an independently owned HomeWell agency still operates at 386 New Brunswick Ave before any outreach.

issues.problem: Avaap is a national Workday/Infor consultancy. Sunnyview Oval in Keasbey is an apartment-complex street, and a second Keasbey directory lists Avaap with a different phone (732-710-3425). No Avaap-owned page ties the firm to this address.

issues.claim: Pequest Associates Inc., 'PO Box 215', Fords, (732) 738-8990 — land surveying
issues.problem: The record carries a mailbox, not a street address, so the business cannot be placed in the zone from the entry itself. Yellow Pages gives 40 Liberty St, Fords with the same phone, so the firm is probably real but the address field is unusable for routing or coverage maths.
issues.fix: Use the street address once confirmed, or mark the address 'unknown — PO box only'.

issues.claim: Coverage: home-services and health categories in Fords
issues.problem: None of the Fords roofing/GC/plumbing/HVAC/cleaning firms are listed, including several on bestprosintown's Fords page — a source this list itself cites (Elite Roofing & Restoration, Carter & Sons Roofing, Tri-County Construction Services, Fizer Plumbing & Heating, Central Air Mechanical, Truclean Cleaners). Chiropractor Lupo Chiropractic Center (786 King George Rd) is also missing. 19 of the 25 eligible businesses my ten searches surfaced are listed (76%, just above the bar); adding those four extra bestprosintown rows drops it to 66%, below the bar.
issues.fix: Add the missing Fords trades, cleaning firms and Lupo Chiropractic Center, or record in the file that those categories sit in an out-of-scope group.

issues.claim: Source citations on several rows (Xclusive Styles and Braids, Iron & Ivy Hair Studio, Design Hair Salon, New Image Dental, The Glam Palace)
issues.problem: Source URLs such as 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/salon+near+Hopelawn+NJ' are search queries, not evidence for a specific business — they cannot be re-opened to confirm that entry's name, address or existence. These rows therefore do not meet the list's own 'needs triage' standard.
issues.fix: Replace each search URL with the business's own site or a specific profile page, or move the row to a 'needs triage' file.
